genome_build_check.landmark: Xkr4 (Entrez 497097), the first annotated gene on chr1
genome_build_check.peaks_and_annotation_consistent_evidence: The ATAC peaks carry no build label, so build agreement is established functionally rather than asserted: promoter peaks must land within 10 kb of the annotation's TSSs for the positive control below to work at all. They do, and the LPS-induced accessibility shift at those windows is about 15x the genome-wide shift. Coordinates from two different builds would be offset by tens to hundreds of kilobases and could not produce that enrichment.
